text: Plan our summer holiday with the kids

title: What kind of summer holiday to take
Rent a lake house somewhere inland (partner's idea)

author: claude
text: From Gothenburg, Siljan is about 450–500 km by car, roughly 5.5–6 hours of driving without stops. Leksand, at the southern end, is the closest; Rättvik and Mora are a bit further. With the kids and breaks, plan for 6.5–7 hours door to door. This is my own estimate and I haven't checked it against a route planner.

reason: It has the best beach for the kids.
